infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: NearNow uses your location only when you choose to: to show posts near you, to place a post on the map, or to send an urgent help alert.
infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: NearNow uses the camera when you choose to add a photo to a post.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: NearNow opens your photo library when you choose a photo for a post or your profile.
